label: Sfx: Ironhail's cast, landing and miss arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: The three voices (v83 §4), in the synth only; the close has none. The arms are added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback, and the fallback line is re-emitted unchanged, so the relics that still fall through keep it (11 others on this link). Through the patched play() every arm reproduces its lab candidate (worst 1e-07; the landing at counts -1, 0, 1-6, 9 and a missing n, on two noise draws), 125 other voices are unchanged (worst 2e-07), and ult/ironhail is no longer rune-crack. play() returns on its first line with no audio context (every headless run), draws no random number and writes nothing the simulation reads; end to end the three voices through the patched page's own SFX.play equal the candidates (worst 9e-08); with Bindweed's, Coldiron's and Portcullis's Sfx rows (the batch's scratch builds) applied too, in either order, every arm of both renders alike.

label: tickHail: the landing voice, once per landed bolt, after its hurt and its sunder
anchor: if (u.sunder > 0){ foe.apply("sunder", u.sunder, d.side); T.sunder += u.sunder; }
why: One plain SFX.play in tickHail's landing, after the hurt and the sunder, so n is the count the foe now carries (foe.stacks is a read). 1906/1906 landings voiced, each n equal to the foe's count (1-6; 67% at the cap; 7 killing); 148/148 fights identical and every other SFX call identical in order and opts; the same rows plus one sim write (the foe nudged 1e-9 on a landing) come back 2/148; end to end, the rows applied as text to a copy of the page: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's.

label: tickHail: the miss voice, once per missed bolt, before the miss line
anchor: if (!foe.alive || !(Math.hypot(foe.x - d.x, foe.y - d.y) < u.hitR + R)){ T.missed++; continue; }
why: One guarded SFX.play BEFORE the miss line, which is re-emitted unchanged: the line's own test, read first (foe.alive and two positions), and the anchor guards it -- if the test ever changes the row stops applying. 5275/5275 misses voiced, each on its landing step (0 on the step the foe died); no miss voice anywhere else; nothing is read back; end to end, the rows applied as text to a copy of the page: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's.
